entities.summary: Santi Romano was an Italian public lawyer. He taught administrative law, constitutional law, ecclesiastical law and international law at several Italian universities, served as President of the Council of State from 1928 to 1944, became a senator of the Kingdom in 1934, and was a member of the Lincean Academy until his dismissal in 1946.
